controls.title: Broken Access Control
controls.summary: Restrictions on what authenticated users are allowed to do are not properly enforced, enabling access to unauthorized functionality or data.
implementationChecklist: Deny by default except for public resources
Enforce access control server-side
Enforce record ownership on every request

controls.title: Cryptographic Failures
controls.summary: Failures related to cryptography (or its absence) that lead to exposure of sensitive data in transit or at rest.
implementationChecklist: Encrypt sensitive data in transit and at rest
Use strong, current algorithms and key sizes
Do not hard-code keys or secrets

controls.title: Injection
controls.summary: User-supplied data is not validated, filtered, or sanitized, allowing hostile data to be interpreted as code or commands.
implementationChecklist: Use safe parameterized APIs
Validate and sanitize all input server-side
Escape output for the correct interpreter context

controls.title: Insecure Design
controls.summary: Missing or ineffective security controls by design — flaws that cannot be fixed by a perfect implementation.
implementationChecklist: Establish and use a secure development lifecycle
Use threat modeling for critical flows
Write unit and integration tests for security controls

controls.title: Security Misconfiguration
controls.summary: Insecure default configurations, incomplete setups, verbose errors, or misconfigured permissions across the stack.
implementationChecklist: Harden all environments consistently
Remove unused features and defaults
Disable verbose error output in production

controls.title: Vulnerable and Outdated Components
controls.summary: Use of components with known vulnerabilities or that are unsupported / out of date.
implementationChecklist: Maintain an inventory of components and versions
Continuously monitor for known vulnerabilities
Patch or remove unsupported components

controls.title: Identification and Authentication Failures
controls.summary: Weaknesses in confirming user identity, authentication, and session management.
implementationChecklist: Enforce strong authentication and MFA where possible
Invalidate sessions on logout and timeout
Protect against credential stuffing and brute force

controls.title: Software and Data Integrity Failures
controls.summary: Code and infrastructure that does not protect against integrity violations, including insecure deserialization and untrusted updates.
implementationChecklist: Verify integrity of components and updates via signatures
Avoid insecure deserialization of untrusted data
Secure the CI/CD pipeline

controls.title: Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
controls.summary: Insufficient logging, detection, monitoring, and active response allows breaches to go unnoticed.
implementationChecklist: Log security-relevant events with sufficient context
Avoid logging sensitive data
Ensure logs feed monitoring and alerting

controls.title: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
controls.summary: The application fetches a remote resource without validating the user-supplied URL, enabling requests to unintended destinations.
implementationChecklist: Validate and allow-list outbound URLs and schemes
Do not send raw responses to clients
Segment and restrict outbound network access
